summary: Comprehensive testing completed for ALLO PIECES 76 quote system. All quote functionality working correctly including form submission, admin management, and mobile responsiveness.

minor_issues.issue: Returns 403 instead of 401 for unauthorized requests
minor_issues.impact: Minor - both status codes indicate authentication issues

design_issues.impact: Console warning only, no functional impact

Quote form submission with all required fields (name, email, phone, plate/VIN, part description)
Quote success message display and modal auto-close
Quote statistics cards (total, pending, processed, quoted)
Quote list display in admin panel
Backend quote APIs (POST, GET, PUT, DELETE)
Authentication and authorization for quote management
